outcome: Perioperative complications of total vaginal hysterectomy
cohort: 742 women who underwent total vaginal hysterectomy over a 5-year period
finding: Prior cesarean section was associated with increased postoperative blood transfusion but did not increase the risk of overall perioperative complications in women undergoing total vaginal hysterectomy.
mod_finding: This study compared perioperative complications of total vaginal hysterectomy in women with and without a prior cesarean section.
